name: kg-suite-fleet-dashboard
description: Single-file static HTML operator dashboard for the Kinetic Gain Protocol Suite. Posture across 6 vertical 6-packs = 36 sibling spec repos × 5 cross-cutting invariants. No framework, no build step. GitHub Pages-deployable. Companion to kg-suite-vertical-router + kg-suite-vertical-comparator.

paragraphs: Kinetic Gain Protocol Suite Fleet Dashboard v0.2. Single-file static HTML operator dashboard showing Suite-wide posture across all 11 vertical 6-packs = 66 sibling spec repos × 5 cross-cutting invariants + 10 AGPL-3.0 reference implementations (covering 10 of 11 verticals — RetailTech ref impl pending) × 2 horizontal composition tools. Built for AI-governance procurement teams operating across mixed regulated-vertical AI vendor portfolios. Dark-themed, no framework, no build step. GitHub Pages-deployable.
Part of the Kinetic Gain Protocol Suite. Companion to kg-suite-vertical-router + kg-suite-vertical-comparator.
